integrity: Proof is constructive and valid for all indicated graph orders. The standalone verifier checks finite examples only and cannot certify infinite claims. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Bipartite bases only; the prism conflict-graph decomposition fails for nonbipartite base cycles. The colouring scalar is a corollary rather than a separate priority claim; independence of the literature is not certified. A plausible 2015 graph-operations source could not be inspected in full.
title: Open-packing complexes of bipartite prisms and the exceptional pure six-rung ladder
